title: Member
description: Definition of Member under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019

content.legal_definition: "member" includes the President and a member of the National Commission or a State Commission or a District Commission, as the case may be;
content.plain_language: A member refers to the President or any person who is part of the National, State, or District Commission.
examples: The President of the National Commission is a member.
A person serving on the State Commission is considered a member.
non_examples: A consumer filing a complaint is not a member.
A business owner is not a member unless they are part of the commission.

user_queries: What is a member of the National Commission?
